confirmed_story_grammar: A specific feature is visibly traced; a linked measurement fact follows; both persist while camera geometry changes. This is information-linked emphasis, not a generic effect beat. The factual content, color, font, pin artwork and source graphics must not be copied.
no_transfer_recommendation: Use target-supported geographic geometry and independently verified target facts if mapping this grammar.
Reference boundary is not a route-flow animation: no moving vehicle, dash stream or repeated flow is visible.
No confirmed isolated reference SFX, repeating pulse, full-screen flash, explosion or particles.
Do not count camera movement or per-character decoration as additional facts.
